facts.fact: MACRA, acting as Malawi's Data Protection Authority, convened a stakeholder consultation meeting in Lilongwe on 15 July 2026 on draft data protection regulations and proposed registration fees (K50,000 to K7 million by turnover), attended by private-sector representatives such as United General Insurance.

The Ministry of Information and Communications Technology, through the Department of E-Government, opened a two-day national validation workshop in Lilongwe on the draft National Digital Transformation Strategy and draft National AI Strategy, bringing together government institutions, regulators, the private sector, civil society and academia; the date is taken as the Wednesday before the 19 February 2026 report.
facts.system: Draft National Digital Transformation Strategy and Draft National AI Strategy

facts.fact: During the validation workshop the government launched the 'Shape Malawi's Digital and AI Future Portal', a public platform to collect wider citizen feedback on the two draft strategies before they are finalised; the document also says the drafts followed regional multi-stakeholder engagements in August 2025.
